description_en: Restarts, pauses, or starts an application on a PolarDB instance without deleting the instance
description_zh: 重启、暂停、启动一个PolarDB实例的应用，不删除实例
name: OperateApplication

parameters.help_en:
The operation type.

restart: Restart.
stop: Stop.
start: Start
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型

restart：重启
stop：停止
start：启动
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en: The Ray component type. Supported only for the restart operation of Ray applications. The value is a comma-separated list of components. Valid components are head, jupyterlab, and grafana, which can be combined. worker or gpuworker is not accepted. To select workers, you must specify GroupNames. If only head is specified, other components are not actively restarted, but connections and jobs may be affected. To restore dependencies, explicitly add jupyterlab or select the entire cluster. When provided together with GroupNames, the union of both is used and deduplicated. If neither selection parameter is provided, all resident components are restarted, but scaled-out workers are not restarted. Explicit empty strings, pure whitespace, comma-only strings, unknown types, or non-Ray applications are rejected and do not fall back to a full-cluster operation. DisableHeadScheduling and EnableHeadScheduling always apply to the head of the entire application. Specifying this parameter for these operations is rejected
parameters.help_zh: Ray 组件类型。仅 Ray 的 restart 支持，逗号分隔，可选 head、jupyterlab、grafana，可组合。不接受 worker 或 gpuworker，选择 worker 必须传 GroupNames。只传 head 时不主动重启其他组件，但可能影响连接和作业；需恢复依赖时显式增加 jupyterlab 或选择整集群。与 GroupNames 同时提供时取并集并去重。两个选择参数均未提供时重启全部常驻组件，不重启弹升 worker。显式空串、纯空白、仅逗号、未知类型或非 Ray 应用均拒绝，不退化为全量操作。DisableHeadScheduling/EnableHeadScheduling 始终作用于整个应用的 head，传入本参数即拒绝
parameters.name: component_types

parameters.help_en: The Ray resident worker group name. Supported only for the restart operation of Ray applications. The value is a comma-separated list of exact workerGroup names, which are trimmed, deduplicated, and case-sensitive. Only resident CPU or GPU workers in the specified groups are restarted, excluding scaled-out workers. If only this parameter is specified, the head, other groups, or auxiliary components are not restarted. Unknown group names, explicit empty strings, pure whitespace, comma-only strings, or non-Ray applications are rejected. If any explicitly selected group exists but has no resident targets, the entire request is rejected and does not expand to scaled-out workers or a full-cluster operation. Full-cluster requests without selection parameters skip groups with no resident targets. DisableHeadScheduling and EnableHeadScheduling do not restart any workers. Specifying this parameter for these operations is rejected
parameters.help_zh: Ray 常驻 worker 组名。仅 Ray 的 restart 支持，逗号分隔的 workerGroup 精确名称，trim 后去重并保留大小写。仅重启指定组的常驻 CPU/GPU worker，不包含弹升 worker；只传本参数时不重启 head、其他组或辅助组件。未知组名、显式空串、纯空白、仅逗号或非 Ray 应用均拒绝。显式选择的任一组存在但无常驻目标时整次请求拒绝，不扩大为弹升或整集群操作；未提供选择参数的整集群请求跳过无常驻目标的组。DisableHeadScheduling/EnableHeadScheduling 不重启任何 worker，传入本参数即拒绝
parameters.name: group_names

TaskId.description_en: The asynchronous task ID. For Ray restart, the parent task ID of restart_ray_cluster is returned. For DisableHeadScheduling and EnableHeadScheduling, the modify_ray_head_scheduling task ID is returned. A success response only indicates that the request is accepted. Historical applications or MCP paths may not return a task ID, and the default output is 0, which does not represent a valid task
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务 ID。Ray restart 返回 restart_ray_cluster 父任务 ID，DisableHeadScheduling/EnableHeadScheduling 返回 modify_ray_head_scheduling 任务 ID。成功仅表示已受理；历史应用或 MCP 路径可能不返回任务 ID，缺省输出为 0，不代表有效任务
